name: ECOWAS
officialName: Economic Community of West African States
aliases: Economic Community of West African States

flag.description: A white field with the ECOWAS emblem in the center: a green ring lettered CEDEAO above and ECOWAS below, around a brown horseshoe and a map of Africa with West Africa picked out in green.
flag.symbolism: The map picks out West Africa within the continent, and the ring carries the community's initials in French and Portuguese (CEDEAO) and in English (ECOWAS).

hook: ECOWAS puts a green-highlighted map of West Africa inside a green ring, CEDEAO on top and ECOWAS underneath, on plain white.
trivia: ECOWAS was founded by the Treaty of Lagos on 28 May 1975.
Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger left in January 2025, cutting the membership from 15 states to 12.
